name: Aurora
tagline: Clear glass chrome over your desktop, a solid chat to read in, and a teal-to-violet accent used sparingly. Light and dark.
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces: a theme file that turns on the Mac's own glass for the window and gives light and dark their own snow and polar-night colors, settings for type and the sidebar's group colors, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for the prompt bubble and cards, and a customize view whose hover card puts its status on chip glass. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
